issues: Modifying the global random state using `random.seed(seed)` can cause unintended side effects in other parts of the application; it is better practice to use a localized random generator instance like `random.Random(seed)`.

The `.strip()` calls on `id_`, `qty`, `code`, and `price` when appending to the rows list are redundant because `re.split(r'\s+', line)` already guarantees that these first four extracted components will not contain any whitespace.
